parts.t: Welcome to The Grove. This lovely unit comes with a fantastic layout offering 2 Bedrooms on the top floor + 1 Bedroom & media room on the ground floor, perfect for you and your family! Other features of this unit include a sleek modern kitchen with ample cupboard space & soft close cabinetry, a great view as this unit looks onto the green area and not back into the complex, fresh paint, and recently done carpeting on the stairs! Amenities for this complex include 2 fitness centers, 2 recreation rooms free to rent for your private functions, a hockey room, and a massive outdoor swimming pool to enjoy in those summer months! The Grove is a family-orientated complex near all your schools, shopping malls & grocery stores! Without a doubt, you're going to LOVE living here.
